professionalSummary.text: Writes and maintains Go services for payment authorisation, retries or reversals.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote a Go retry service for soft-declined card authorisations at Kestrel Merchant Services, storing idempotency keys in PostgreSQL so that a retried request could never be charged twice.

experienceHighlights.text: Writes design documents covering failure modes, idempotency and rollback for payment services.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reviewed pull requests for the authorisation gateway team and wrote the team's guide to structured logging for payment events.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Takes part in an on-call rota for a batch or settlement system and works incidents through the runbooks.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Served on the settlement batch on-call rota from October 2022 to January 2024, working incidents through the team's runbooks and filing post-incident reviews for two batch overruns.

skills.text: Shows a measured reduction in failed or wrongly declined payments against a documented baseline and time window.
skills.witness: Recruiter call note: on the screening call the candidate passed on a remark from a former team lead that the retry service 'cut failed card payments by roughly 40%'. The candidate did not have the underlying figures.
